app.name: Lendbox
home.eyebrow: A library of things for your neighborhood
home.title: Borrow what you need. Lend what you don't use.
home.lead: Most of what we own sits in a closet, and most of what we need, we need once.
home.how.title: How it works
home.how.1: Find an item nearby and pick your dates.
home.how.2: The owner approves; you get the pickup spot.
home.how.3: Pay the owner in person. Lendbox never charges you.
footer.note: A noticeboard for neighbors. Lendbox is not a party to the loan.

signup.name: Display name
signup.name.hint: Your first name and an initial is enough.
signup.error.name: Enter a name between 1 and 60 characters.
signup.error.taken: An account with this email already exists. Log in instead.
signup.sent.title: Check your email
signup.sent.body: We sent a confirmation link to {email}. It works for 48 hours.
signup.sent.dev: Development mode: open the confirmation link directly.
login.title: Log in

login.error.throttled: Too many attempts. Wait 15 minutes and try again.
browse.title: Find something to borrow
browse.empty.title: Nothing matches yet
browse.empty.body: Try other dates or a wider area. Things that are booked come back when they are returned.

item.request.title: Request these dates

lending.title: Your lending
lending.overlap: These dates overlap with another request. Approving one declines the other automatically.
lending.empty.requests: No requests yet. Clear photos and a fair deposit help people say yes.

flash.verify_failed: That link is used or expired. Log in and ask for a new one.

flash.declined: Declined. The borrower will see it.

error.own_item: You can't borrow your own item.
error.range: Pick a return date after the start date.

listing.new.title: List an item
listing.new.category: What kind of item is it?
listing.prohibited: Cars, scooters, weapons and medication can't be listed. Lending them needs insurance or a license.
listing.title: Title
listing.title.hint: Say what it is and what comes with it.
listing.price: Price per day in ILS (0 means free)
listing.deposit.hint: Add a deposit, even a small one. It protects you if the item comes back damaged.
listing.area.hint: Only the neighborhood is public. You share the exact spot after you approve.
listing.error.title: Use 3 to 80 characters.
listing.error.deposit: Add a deposit, even a small one. It protects you if the item comes back damaged.
manage.title: Manage listing
manage.publish.note: It goes live at once. There is no approval queue.
borrowing.title: Your borrowing
borrowing.empty: You haven't asked for anything yet.
booking.pickup.locked: The exact pickup spot appears here after the owner approves.
review.title: How did it go?
review.blind: Reviews are blind: yours shows once the other side reviews too, or after 14 days.
community.empty: Nobody is lending here yet. Be the first: list one item, or post what you're looking for so lenders nearby can see it.
looking.title: People are looking for
looking.post.title: What do you need?
flash.listing_saved: Draft saved. Check it, then publish.

flash.reviewed: Thanks. It will show once the other side reviews too.
flash.posted: Posted. Lenders nearby can see it.

error.looking_title: Use 3 to 80 characters for what you need.
signup.agree: By signing up you agree to the Terms and the Community guidelines.
listing.error.contact: Keep phone numbers and emails out of the public text. Put pickup details in the private field; you can share contact details in the booking thread after you approve.

error.rate_limited: That's a lot in a short time. Please wait a while and try again.

flash.reported: Thanks. An admin will look at it.
admin.title: Reports
demo.banner: This is a demo. Everyone and everything here is made up, and the data resets every day.
demo.title: Try it in one click
demo.lead: Step into a ready-made account. As a lender you can approve requests and mark returns; as a borrower you can request dates, message owners and write reviews.
demo.note: No sign-up and no email. Whatever you change disappears at the next daily reset.
demo.signup_off: Sign-up is turned off in the demo. Use Try the demo on the home page to step into a ready-made account.
